Shell.Tools.Picture.Name: Picture tools
Shell.Tools.Picture.About: Upscale pictures, clean up softness, noise and JPEG blocks, and repair the faces in them — in the image editor, or when you ask the assistant. Real-ESRGAN and GFPGAN.
Shell.Tools.Selection.Name: Picture selection
Shell.Tools.Selection.About: Pick things out of pictures — click them, draw a box round them, or name them — and cut them out of their background, in the image viewer and editor or when you ask the assistant. SAM 3.1.
Shell.Tools.Reading.Name: Page reading
Shell.Tools.Reading.About: Read pages of writing — scans, photographed pages, scanned PDFs — into Markdown: columns as one text, formulas as LaTeX, tables, and figures, in the image and PDF viewers or when you ask the assistant. Unlimited-OCR and PP-OCRv5.
Shell.Tools.Erasing.Name: Erasing
Shell.Tools.Checking.Name: Picture safety check
Shell.Tools.Checking.About: While Enhanced AI Protection Mode is on, every picture made is checked before it is saved or shown, and one unfit for a general audience is withheld. Fetched the first time a picture is made; runs on the CPU in a few milliseconds. OwenElliott's image safety classifier.
Shell.Tools.SceneDepth.Name: Scene depth
Shell.Tools.StoppedTwice: {0} It stopped again when asked once more; something on this machine is in its way for now.
Shell.Tools.SceneDepth.About: Tell what is near and what is far in a photo from the photo alone — for a lens blur focused where you click, haze that thickens with distance, or selecting by distance — in the image editor or when you ask the assistant about a picture you have open. Runs on the GPU, or the CPU where there is none. Depth Anything V2 Small.
Shell.Tools.Erasing.About: Rub scratches, dust, wires, people or signs out of photos and fill where they were from what is round them, in the image editor or when you ask the assistant about a picture you have open. LaMa.

Shell.Components.NvidiaGpu.Name: NVIDIA GPU
Shell.Components.NvidiaGpu.Description: Nexaflow's own AI models run on an NVIDIA GPU with memory of its own. Without one they run on the CPU, and the models that need a GPU — pictures, picture edits, video — cannot run.
Shell.Components.NvidiaGpu.NoneFormat: No NVIDIA GPU was found, so local models run on the CPU. Found: {0}
Shell.Components.NvidiaGpu.IntegratedFor: It shares the PC's memory; local models need an NVIDIA GPU with memory of its own, so they run on the CPU. Found: {0}
Shell.Components.NvidiaGpu.NoAdapters: Windows reports no adapter that can run AI models, so local models run on the CPU.
Shell.Components.CudaDriver.Name: NVIDIA CUDA driver
Shell.Components.CudaDriver.DescriptionF: The CUDA support in NVIDIA's driver. Nexaflow's GPU runtime is built for CUDA {0}, so the driver must support CUDA {0} or newer.
Shell.Components.CudaDriver.TooOldFormat: This driver supports CUDA {0}; Nexaflow's GPU runtime needs CUDA {1} or newer. Update the NVIDIA driver and restart Nexaflow — until then local models run on the CPU.
Shell.Components.CudaDriver.Absent: No NVIDIA driver answered for CUDA. Install NVIDIA's driver and restart Nexaflow — until then local models run on the CPU.
Shell.Components.CudaDriver.NotNeeded: Only an NVIDIA GPU uses it, and none was found.
Shell.Components.CudaPack.Name: CUDA runtime pack
Shell.Components.CudaPack.DescriptionFor: NVIDIA's CUDA libraries and the GPU builds of the AI runtimes, about {0}, downloaded once beside the local models. Without it Nexaflow's own models cannot use the GPU.
Shell.Components.CudaPack.PartFormat: {0} of {1} files downloaded and verified. Local models on this PC run on its GPU, so they wait for the pack; it downloads with the next local model fetched.
Shell.Components.CudaPack.NotNeededForma: Not needed here: without an NVIDIA GPU of its own and a CUDA {0} driver, local models run on the CPU.
